payload.artist_html: W. J. Freimuth, J. R. Lively, L. E. Zanno
payload.credit_html: "Reassessment of the Early Cretaceous North American "troodontid" Geminiraptor suarezarum as a therizinosaurian and mosaic evolution of coelurosaurian maxillae"
payload.description_html: Diagnostic postcranial elements of Falcarius. Numbered features correspond to those in the genus diagnosis. (A) Cervical vertebra (Fa. utahensis NCSM 35019) in ventral view. (B) Cranial dorsal vertebra (Fa. utahensis UMNH VP 14534) in right lateral view. (C) Distal caudal vertebra (Fa. utahensis NCSM 28026) in left lateral view. (D) Manual ungual PI-2 (Fa. utahensis UMNH VP 12314) in lateral view. (E) Manual ungual PI-2 (Fa. suarezarum CEUM 78330) in lateral view. (F) Chevron (Fa. suarezarum CEUM 78314) in left lateral view. (G) Right humerus (Fa. utahensis UMNH VP 12284) in cranial view. (H) Right humerus (Fa. suarezarum CEUM 77102) in cranial view. (I) Left pubis (Fa. utahensis UMNH VP 14539) in lateral view. (J) Left pubis (Fa. suarezarum CEUM 78261) in lateral view. Scale bars 1 cm (A–F), 5 cm (G–J).
